harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves an EL10-compatible local DNF repository over HTTP. With the standard CentOS repository definitions inactive, tree-2.1.0-8.el10.x86_64 was installed solely from local-storage. The repository, package, firewall configuration, OS release, and kernel all persisted across the required reboot.
actions_performed: Created /var/www/html/localrepo containing the tree RPM and repository metadata.
Configured and enabled Apache, including the persistent firewalld HTTP service.
Added the local-storage DNF repository targeting node1's managed IP.
Moved the usual CentOS repository definitions into /etc/yum.repos.d/remote-disabled and cleared cached metadata.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: Apache is enabled and active; the repository metadata returns HTTP 200 from node1's managed IP.

evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unavailable
evidence.summary: Only local-storage was enabled during installation; tree was initially absent, installed from local-storage, and subsequently verified.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 remained unchanged; all installed components are EL10 packages.

Healthy baseline boot ID 4cee4ea8-4b8e-4c2f-af1a-3a82b9ec41f4 was captured, the reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with changed boot ID 54e4ca0c-7129-401c-9d76-79bfa702622e. Apache, HTTP repository access, local metadata, installed package, and system health recovered with zero failed units.
